verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Qualcomm's developer SDKs and AI Hub tooling (AI Engine Direct SDK, model runtime, cloud device profiling) but no documented public REST/HTTP API or OpenAPI spec for driving the Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme itself; direct probes for openapi.json/swagger.json and developer.md all returned 404s, and the vendor spec page is JS-only with no API documentation surfaced.
